title: High Elf Female Units Collection 1.0.0
author: WGEXP
description:
Hi everyone, the High Elf Female Units Collection mod is now available.

Please remember to extract the files after downloading. After installation,disable all separate High Elf unit mods to avoid conflicts.

To install, simply copy the downloaded attachment to the 'steamapps/common/Total War WARHAMMER III/data' directory in your Steam folder. Then, when launching the game, don't forget to enable it in the mod list within the mod manager.

If you enjoy my mods, please consider following my patreon page.
